subject.title: [Bug]: Native Mac App WebChat cannot open server-hosted images (Open/Download buttons unresponsive, browser Control UI works)

question: How should native macOS WebChat fetch, open, and download Gateway-managed image URLs while preserving owner-auth and session context?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable fix crosses native UI, macOS transport, Gateway auth, and user-visible open/download behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Native Authenticated Media Actions
options.body: Decode managed image fields in native chat and have the macOS transport fetch bytes with Gateway/session auth before opening or saving them.

options.title: Gateway-Issued Native Media Tickets
options.body: Add a scoped media URL contract that native clients can open directly without assuming browser-only auth behavior.

options.title: Defer Native Actions
options.body: Keep browser Control UI as the supported workaround and leave native WebChat without managed-image Open/Download until a broader media contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Native Authenticated Media Actions
recommendation.body: Decode managed image fields in native chat and have the macOS transport fetch bytes with Gateway/session auth before opening or saving them.

likelyOwner.reason: The main unresolved design choice is how native macOS should consume the managed-image and owner-auth Gateway contract.
